design_protocol.rewrite_when: after P4-A, P4-B and P4-C terminal delivery and consolidated scientific review
design_protocol.data_and_weight_reference: records/assets.json and frozen split manifests at source_commit; reuse accepted model-byte hashes, do not rehash all 508 checkpoints merely for administrative signoff

common_training.algorithm_scope: inherit accepted P2 mathematical pipeline and parameter-group exclusions; no topology, augmentation or initialization substitutions

budget.forecast: actual_spent + 1.25 * future_work + required_exit_reserve; never reinflate past actuals
budget.reallocation: documented within approved total for registered tasks only; cannot expand scientific scope

bootstrap.duplicate_sensitivity: use_frozen_duplicate_ids; cluster bootstrap and fixed train-match test-exclusion subset only as exploratory; full official test stays primary

calibration.brier: mean(sum((p-one_hot_y)^2, axis=class)); no division by number of classes

occlusion.sample_selection: use actual P0 pool if present; otherwise new outcome-independent P4 SHA-based pool, never backdate

B.start_from: fresh original weights or random initialization per method; never P3 checkpoint

C.splits: official setid.mat, not resplit or swapped
C.normalization: same frozen per-backbone configuration as P3
C.test_release: after explicit PI adoption of P4 execution scope, all 40 runs terminal, 8 LR choices frozen, checkpoint/role/analysis manifests sealed and budget checks passed; no repeated manual HMAC required

primary_question.criterion: lower bound of ordinary two-sided 95% paired t interval strictly > -0.5pp

C.selection: validation max Top1 then earliest epoch; tuning mean epochs13-15 then smaller LR

autonomy.routine_engineering_fix_and_restore: allowed within approved protocol and total cap; log evidence and charge time
autonomy.individual_numerical_failure: terminal for that run, preserve evidence; no silent LR/precision fallback

design_matrix.note: Learning rates for 40 formal jobs and identities for 80 evaluations must be resolved from new train/validation evidence; these nulls are not permissions to guess.
